fact: The chapter reports testing selected Namibian government websites with Lighthouse, WAVE, the W3C validator, ChromeVox and an alt-text tester, finding the automatic tools gave varied and inconclusive results.

Paradigm Initiative's LONDA 2023 report says explicit details on digital inclusion of persons with disabilities are not available beyond a vague reference in the 2019 Broadband Policy, and that the National Disability Act of 2004 does not mention the internet or digitisation.
